region_label: Nature Coast — Cedar Key, Crystal River, Homosassa
notes:
HONEST READ ON INVENTORY: true single-house 6-8BR stock on the Nature Coast is genuinely thin — this is a region of 2-3BR fish camps, stilt cottages and condos, not big-house country. Across ~35 searches I found only four properties that are unambiguously 6BR+ under one roof/one booking: The Oar House at Steinhatchee Landing (6BR + attic loft, listed 7BR), 'Float, Relax, Repeat' on the Rainbow River (6BR/4.5BA), the Crystal River 'Manatee and Scalloping Adventure Retreat' (6BR/3BA, but only sleeps 12 and 3 of the 6 'bedrooms' are a den/office/game room), and the Rainbow River Mid-Century Estate (5BR main house + 2BR guest cottage = 7BR, sold as one booking). Everything else in the 12-18 person range here is a compound or a 4-5BR standout.

CEDAR KEY SPECIFICALLY: I could not find a single 6BR house on Cedar Key. I enumerated the two dominant island PMs — McCormick Management (cedarkeytime.com, 18 listings, largest is Whispering Waves at 4BR/12) and Pelican Vacation Home (pelicanvacationhome.com, ~100 listings, largest single-family homes are 4BR sleeping 10-11). Cozycozy's 724-rental Cedar Key aggregate topped out at 3BR. On Cedar Key the realistic shape for 12-18 people is (a) two or three adjacent units booked through one PM — Pelican manages whole complexes like Old Fenimore Mill and Island Place and can block multiple units, or (b) the boat-access private island property below. Note Cedar Key was hit hard by Hurricanes Idalia/Helene; some inventory has changed hands, so call before assuming a listing is live.

SOURCES TRIED: Gulf Coast Getaways, McCormick Management/cedarkeytime, Pelican Vacation Home, Cedar Key Chamber, Citrus County Vacation Homes, TradeWinds Homosassa, Steinhatchee River Rentals, Steinhatchee Landing Resort, Steinhatchee Retreats, Fiddler's on the River, Homosassa River Retreat, FloridaRentals.com, Plantation on Crystal River, Evolve, Marriott Homes & Villas, HiChee, RentByOwner, VacationRenter, cozycozy, Hipcamp, Glamping Hub, Booking.com, Expedia, Trip.com, Vrbo, Airbnb.

BLOCKED / DEGRADED: Airbnb and Vrbo listing pages blocked automated fetch throughout (expected) — Airbnb/Vrbo entries below are built from search snippets and aggregator mirrors, marked fetch_blocked. TradeWinds Homosassa returns HTTP 202 to non-browser clients (bot wall) — its large-group page could only be read via search snippets. Booking.com, TripAdvisor, VacationRenter and PickleTrip/Varoom returned 403/empty JS shells. Expedia rate-limited (429) after the first fetch. Gulf Coast Getaways and Steinhatchee River Rentals load prices via a Hostaway JS widget, so no dated pricing was readable.

GLAMPING/UNIQUE: Hipcamp and Glamping Hub in this region are single-tent/single-cabin scale (Wildflower Ranch near Chiefland has one bell tent + one cabin; Black Prong in Bronson has tiny homes and cottages with attached horse stalls). Nothing there books as a 12-18 person unit, so I did not list them as properties — Black Prong is the only one worth a phone call if the family wants an equestrian ranch compound.

DECEMBER / MANATEE SEASON: Dec 19-27 is peak manatee season in Kings Bay (Crystal River) — the manatees crowd into the 72-degree springs Nov-Mar and this is the single best week of the year for it. That also means it is the highest-demand week for Crystal River lodging; the Plantation's manatee tours and the in-water swim tours book out weeks ahead, so tours should be reserved separately and early regardless of where the house is. Scalloping (Jul-Sep) is irrelevant for this trip but drives the 3-night minimums quoted on several listings. Several operators quote a 3-night holiday minimum; none I found quoted a 7-night holiday minimum, so an 8-night Dec 19-27 booking is not structurally blocked.

AVAILABILITY: I could not verify live Dec 19-27 2026 availability anywhere — every calendar was JS-loaded or behind a bot wall. All entries are marked 'unknown' except where noted.

DRIVE TIMES (useful for a multi-gen group): Tampa (TPA) is ~1h30 to Crystal River/Homosassa, ~2h15 to Cedar Key, ~3h15 to Steinhatchee. Gainesville (GNV) is ~1h to Cedar Key. Orlando (MCO) is ~1h45 to Dunnellon/Rainbow River.

properties.name: The Oar House at Steinhatchee Landing Resort
properties.source: Steinhatchee Landing Resort (also listed on Airbnb / RentByOwner)
properties.beds_note: Not fully stated. Described as five bedrooms on the third floor and one on the second floor, plus an attic loft with 6 wall-recessed double beds and its own full bath and sun deck. Some aggregators list it as 7BR/6BA because they count the loft. Per-bedroom king/queen split not published — must confirm by phone.
properties.price_note: Aggregator 'best rates from $669/night'; 8 nights x $669 = $5,352 before cleaning, fees and 11-12% FL lodging tax. Holiday-week pricing is likely higher — treat as a floor, not a quote.
properties.why: The single largest true house in the region and the strongest literal match to 6-8BR: a six-bedroom riverfront cottage with a private dock, inside a 35-acre Victorian/Florida-Cracker cottage resort with a pool, hot tub and petting zoo. The attic loft with six recessed beds is a natural kid floor, and a dining table seating 14 means the whole family eats together — the thing that usually breaks in a group this size.
properties.cons: Steinhatchee is the farthest point in this region from everything: ~3h15 from Tampa, ~2h from Gainesville, and about 1h50 from the Crystal River manatee springs, so the 'Crystal springs' part of the trip becomes a long day trip rather than a morning. Bed configuration is unpublished and the loft's six 'double beds' are almost certainly not kings. December is off-season here (the town revolves around summer scalloping), so some restaurants and charters run reduced hours.
properties.availability_note: No public calendar readable; resort books by phone or via bookingcenter.com. Call Steinhatchee Landing at 850-295-1526 or 888-404-2602 to check Dec 19-27 2026.
properties.min_stay_note: Resort quotes 2-night minimum generally, 3 nights during scallop season and holidays. No holiday minimum longer than 3 nights found.

properties.name: Rainbow River Mid-Century Estate (Rainbow River Estate on Blue Run)
properties.neighborhood: Blue Run / Rainbow River, 9-acre riverfront estate
properties.compound_note: Main house (5BR / 5.5BA) plus a separate guest cottage (2BR / 2BA) on the same 9-acre parcel, rented together as one booking. 7 bedrooms total, stated capacity 22-24+.
properties.beds_note: not stated — bed-by-bed configuration is not published on any of the aggregator mirrors I could read. Airbnb listing page blocked automated fetch.
properties.price_note: No rate published on any readable mirror (Trip.com and Booking.com both showed date-dependent pricing only). Comparable 5BR Rainbow River riverfront homes run $490-800/night, so budget roughly $700-1,200/night for an estate this size at Christmas — unverified.
properties.why: The best-shaped property I found for a 12-18 person multi-generational group: a 5BR main house for the adults plus a detached 2BR cottage that gives grandparents or a young family their own front door, on nine private acres with 220 feet of frontage on the spring-fed Rainbow River. The yard-game inventory (shuffleboard, cornhole, ping pong, basketball) is exactly what keeps a mixed-age group occupied for eight days, and the Rainbow is 72 degrees year-round so it is swimmable in December.
properties.cons: Bedroom count runs to the top of the range (7BR) and capacity 22+ means you may be paying for more house than you need. Bed configuration is completely unpublished — the king-bed preference cannot be checked without calling. Dunnellon is inland: ~50 min to the Crystal River manatee springs and ~1h45 from Tampa. No pool mentioned, and December river swimming is bracing even at 72 degrees.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked automated fetch; no dated calendar readable. Also mirrored on Booking.com as 'Rainbow River Estate on Blue Run' and on Trip.com (hotel-detail-132018870) if you want a second booking channel.
properties.min_stay_note: not stated. Trip.com mirror notes minimum guest age 26, check-in after 3pm, check-out before 2pm.

properties.name: Ozello Coastal Estate (Ozello Coastal Manor + Ozello Coastal Lodge)
properties.compound_note: Two adjoining waterfront homes sold as one booking: Ozello Coastal Manor (4BR / 2.5BA, sleeps 8) and Ozello Coastal Lodge (2BR / 2BA, sleeps 6). Shared dock and outdoor amenities. Both are also listed individually by the same PM, so the combined booking is the PM's own packaged product, not a hack.
properties.beds_note: Stated as 3 king, 2 queen, 1 double, plus 1 futon in an office and 1 fold-out couch in a living room. Three kings across six bedrooms is the best king ratio I confirmed anywhere in this region.
properties.price_note: Rates load through a Hostaway JS widget that does not render to automated fetch; nothing published statically. PM offers 5% weekly / 15% monthly discounts. Call for a Dec 19-27 quote.
properties.why: The strongest Crystal River option and the best fit for the manatee half of the trip: 6BR/14 beds across two adjoining waterfront homes about 20 minutes from Kings Bay, where December is the peak of manatee season. Ozello is the real old-Florida article — a winding road out through the salt marsh to stilt houses on the Gulf — and the two-house layout gives the group natural separation without splitting the booking. Three king beds is the best confirmed king count in the region.
properties.cons: Sleeps 14, so an 18-person group would not fit. Two separate buildings means no single big room where all 14 gather indoors — meals split or move outside. No pool. Ozello is remote even by Nature Coast standards: ~25 min to a grocery store, and the causeway road is dark and narrow at night. Pet limit is one small dog.
properties.availability_note: Hostaway booking widget renders client-side and returned 'Loading...' to automated fetch, so Dec 19-27 2026 could not be checked. Call 850-703-3076.

properties.name: Float, Relax, Repeat — Brand New 6BR/4.5BA Waterfront Home on Rainbow River
properties.neighborhood: Rainbow River, steps from K.P. Hole County Park
properties.beds_note: not stated — bed configuration not published on any mirror I could read; Expedia rate-limited and VacationRenter returned 403.
properties.price_note: No rate readable — Expedia returned HTTP 429 on fetch and the price is date-dependent. Comparable Rainbow River riverfront homes in the area run $450-800/night.
properties.why: A genuine six-bedroom under one roof directly on the Rainbow River, which is rare here — most 6BR results in this region turn out to be compounds. Three storeys of floor-to-ceiling glass over spring-fed water, a hot tub, and it sits steps from K.P. Hole County Park and a five-minute walk from Rainbow Springs State Park, so tubing and the springs are on foot rather than in the car.
properties.cons: Sleeps count is not published anywhere I could read — 6BR/4.5BA suggests 12-16 but this needs confirming before booking for 18. Bed configuration entirely unknown, so the king preference is unverifiable. Three storeys of stairs is a real issue for a multi-generational group with grandparents. Inland: ~50 min to the Crystal River manatees, ~1h45 from Tampa. New-build character rather than old-Florida character.
properties.availability_note: Expedia returned 429 and Vrbo/Airbnb blocked automated fetch, so Dec 19-27 2026 could not be checked. Searchable by the exact name 'Float, Relax, Repeat' on Vrbo and Airbnb.

properties.name: Manatee and Scalloping Adventure Retreat
properties.neighborhood: Wooded residential neighborhood near golf course, inland of Kings Bay
properties.beds_note: Stated as 2 king, 1 queen, 4 twin, 1 sofa bed. Note the owner counts a game room, den and office (all with doors) toward the 6 bedrooms — only 3 are described as true 'huge primary bedrooms'.
properties.price_note: Listed base rate range $187-$401/night depending on season; $401 is the high-season figure and December is high season, so 8 x $401 = $3,208 before fees and 11% tax. Owner books direct with no platform booking fee.
amenities: game room with foosball and video games
child safety pool fence on request
properties.why: The best value in the manatee corridor and the only 6BR I found with a private heated pool — which matters in December when the Gulf is cold but a heated pool is not. Positioned between Crystal River, Homosassa Springs and Weeki Wachee, so all three spring systems are short drives, and the game room plus sauna give teenagers and grandparents somewhere separate to be.
properties.cons: Only sleeps 12, at the bottom of the 12-18 range — and the 6-bedroom count is generous, since a den, office and game room are counted as bedrooms. Only 3 bathrooms for 12 people. Four twin beds and one queen means the king preference largely fails here. Not waterfront — it is an inland subdivision with no dock or river access, so the old-Florida character is absent.
properties.availability_note: Listing page renders statically but the availability calendar is not exposed to automated fetch. Book direct through FloridaRentals.com contact form (host Michael Eash).

properties.name: Southern Pines Lodge at Steinhatchee Landing Resort
properties.neighborhood: Steinhatchee Landing Resort, across from the pool, short walk to docks
properties.beds_note: Per the Steinhatchee Retreats description: Bedroom 1 (downstairs, handicap accessible) 1 king; Bedroom 2 three twins plus roll-away; Bedroom 3 1 king; Bedroom 4 two queens; game room has 2 sets of single-over-double bunks. Bunk count above is beds not sets. Two of five bedrooms are kings.
properties.price_note: Published range $500-$799/night; midpoint $650 x 8 nights = $5,200 before cleaning, fees and tax. December is off-season in Steinhatchee so the lower end of the range is plausible.
properties.why: Six bathrooms for 18 people is the real headline — that ratio is better than anything else in the region and it is what actually determines whether a multi-generational week is pleasant. Two kings, a ground-floor handicap-accessible bedroom for grandparents, and full resort amenities (pool, hot tub, sauna, petting zoo, archery) inside a 35-acre oak hammock. Pair it with a second Landing cottage to clear 6-8BR if the group runs large.
properties.cons: FLAGGED: this is a 5-bedroom, below your 6-8BR requirement — included because the bathroom ratio, bed count and accessible ground-floor bedroom make it genuinely exceptional for a group this shape. Sources conflict on the count (Steinhatchee River Rentals says 5BR/18; Steinhatchee Retreats describes 4 bedrooms plus a bunk room in the game area sleeping up to 20) — confirm which. Steinhatchee is ~3h15 from Tampa and ~1h50 from the Crystal River manatees. Some sleeping is in game-room bunks rather than real bedrooms.
properties.availability_note: Requested the page with Dec 19-27 2026 date parameters; the calendar did not render to automated fetch and only the static $500-$799 range was returned. Call 850-843-2660.
properties.min_stay_note: 2-night minimum; 3 nights during scallop season and holidays. An 8-night Christmas stay is not blocked by any stated maximum.

properties.name: Cedar Key private island — boat-access-only main house + bungalow
properties.source: Airbnb (direct listing URL not recoverable — see availability_note)
properties.neighborhood: Private island offshore, Gulf of Mexico
properties.compound_note: Main house (2,800 sq ft, sleeps 13, described as having three master suites within 7 total bedrooms) plus a separate bungalow on the same island sleeping up to 4 — 17 total. Whole island rents as one booking.
properties.beds_note: not stated. Three 'master suites' are mentioned, which usually implies king or queen, but no configuration is published in any snippet I could retrieve.
properties.price_note: No rate found. Airbnb blocked automated fetch and the listing did not surface with a price in any search snippet.
amenities: multiple docks for up to 3 boats
canoe, paddle boat and kayaks included
9-10 person deck boat available to rent on site
properties.why: By far the most characterful thing in the region and the only Cedar Key property I found that reaches 6-8BR: an entire private island off Cedar Key, reachable only by boat, with a quarter mile of Gulf shoreline, three master suites in a 2,800 sq ft main house, a separate bungalow, and a deck boat available on site. For a family that asked for 'a house or other cool accommodations', this is the answer — nobody forgets a week on their own island.
properties.cons: SIGNIFICANT CAVEAT: I could not recover the direct listing URL. The property appears repeatedly and consistently in Airbnb search snippets for Cedar Key with the same specific details (2,800 sq ft, sleeps 13, bungalow sleeps 4, three master suites, 3 boats, fish cleaning station), but Airbnb blocked every attempt to fetch a listing page, so the URL above is the Cedar Key waterfront search page, not the listing. Treat this entry as a strong lead to run down by hand, not a verified booking. Beyond that: boat-only access is a genuine logistical burden for a multi-generational group over 8 days — every grocery run, every airport pickup and any medical issue is a boat trip, and December Gulf weather can turn. Bathroom count, bed configuration and price are all unknown.
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked automated fetch (fetch_blocked). Find it by searching Airbnb for Cedar Key with filters for 13+ guests, or ask the Cedar Key Chamber of Commerce (cedarkey.org) which knows the island rentals — they maintain the local houses-and-cottages directory.

properties.name: Fiddler's on the River — Pool House + Cooey's Cottage (multi-cottage booking)
properties.neighborhood: Steinhatchee village, one block from the restaurant
properties.compound_note: Two cottages from one operator booked together: The Pool House (4BR + 3 pull-out beds / 3BA, sleeps 13, has the swimming pool, pool table and game room) plus Cooey's Cottage (3BR / 2BA, sleeps 6, king bed and two full beds, boat slip on weekly stays). 7 bedrooms and 19 beds total. Both are handled by the same office on one phone number, so it is a single call — but confirm they will write it as one reservation.
properties.beds_note: Only Cooey's Cottage publishes a configuration: 1 king and 2 full beds. The Pool House is listed as 4 bedrooms plus 3 pull-out beds with no per-room detail. Combined counts above are partial — the Pool House's 4 bedrooms are not broken out.
properties.price_note: Nightly rates not published; only cleaning fees are listed ($200 Pool House, $150 Cooey's = $350 combined). Call for a Dec 19-27 quote on both cottages.
properties.why: The cleanest compound in Steinhatchee and cheaper than the Landing: two cottages a block apart from one operator, totalling 7 bedrooms and 19 sleeping spots, with the Pool House carrying a swimming pool and game room as the group's daytime hub. Walking distance to Fiddler's own restaurant on the river solves at least a couple of the eight dinners.
properties.cons: Two buildings a block apart, not adjacent — small kids move between them outdoors and there is no single gathering room for 19. Bed configuration for the Pool House's 4 bedrooms is unpublished, and 3 of the 13 Pool House sleepers are on pull-outs. Only Cooey's is pet-friendly. Steinhatchee is ~3h15 from Tampa and ~1h50 from the Crystal River manatees, and December is the town's quiet season.
properties.availability_note: No online calendar; the resort books by phone. Call 352-498-7427 and ask specifically whether both cottages are free Dec 19-27 2026 and can go on one reservation.

properties.name: Old Homosassa 5BR/5BA across from the canal
properties.source: Citrus County Vacation Homes (listed on Airbnb)
properties.neighborhood: Old Homosassa, across from the canal
properties.compound_note: Not a compound as listed — but the same PM also manages 'Old Homosassa 4/2 Near Three Ramps' (https://www.vrbo.com/3299218, sleeps up to 21, with RV hookup) nearby. Booking both through Citrus County Vacation Homes on one call would give 9BR across two Old Homosassa houses; ask them to pair the two.
properties.beds_note: not stated — Airbnb listing blocked automated fetch; the PM's index page lists only bedroom/bath counts.
properties.price_note: No rate published on the PM index; Airbnb blocked fetch. Call 352-464-5521 for a Dec 19-27 quote.
properties.why: Five bedrooms with five full bathrooms is an unusually good ratio, and Old Homosassa is the most atmospheric village in the manatee corridor — the Freezer, MacRae's and Homosassa Springs Wildlife State Park are all minutes away, and Kings Bay is about 25 minutes north for December manatee swims. The managing PM has a deep Old Homosassa portfolio, which makes pairing a second house straightforward.
properties.cons: FLAGGED: 5 bedrooms, below your 6-8BR requirement — included because the 5-bath ratio and the PM's ability to pair a second nearby house make it a practical route to 9BR. Sleeps count, bed configuration, amenities and price are all unpublished; almost everything here needs a phone call. Not confirmed waterfront (described as 'across from' the canal, not on it).
properties.availability_note: Airbnb blocked automated fetch. Citrus County Vacation Homes at 352-464-5521 manages it directly and can check Dec 19-27 2026 across their whole portfolio in one call.

properties.name: UpTheCreek at Mason Creek Preserve — house + loft + studio
properties.compound_note: Three separately-listed spaces on one property that book together for 16: the main house (3BR / 2BA, sleeps 9), the loft, and the studio (1BR / 1BA each, sleeping ~2-4 apiece). All three are the same owner and the same address, so they can be reserved as a set — but they are three separate listings, so expect three bookings unless the owner combines them.
properties.beds_note: not stated for the main house. The studio is 1BR/1BA sleeping 2. No king/queen breakdown published.
properties.price_note: Main house shows $205-$213/night on aggregator mirrors; the studio averages $275/night on Airbnb. Combined all-three pricing is not published — the $275 figure is the studio alone, so a combined total cannot be estimated honestly.
amenities: canal access to Halls River and Homosassa River
private nature preserve and wetland setting
properties.why: A three-part compound in the prettiest corner of Old Homosassa — built 2019, set inside protected preserve and wetland land across from the photographed twin roosters on Mason Creek, with canal access that puts you in the springs or at a waterfront restaurant by boat in minutes. December manatee season at Homosassa Springs is right there, and the house/loft/studio split gives three generations three front doors.
properties.cons: FLAGGED: 5 bedrooms total (3 in the house, 1 each in loft and studio), below your 6-8BR requirement, even though it sleeps 16. Booking is across three separate listings, which risks one of the three going while you arrange the others. Boat access is restricted — flats or pontoon boats only, and you must be able to lower the bimini to clear Halls River Bridge. Bed configuration entirely unpublished.
properties.availability_note: Vrbo and Airbnb both blocked automated fetch. Main house is Vrbo 2020062 / Airbnb 45091822; the studio is a separate listing. Message the owner to hold all three for Dec 19-27 2026.

properties.name: Island home on Kings Bay — manatees at the dock
properties.neighborhood: Private crescent island in Kings Bay
properties.beds_note: Stated as 2 king bedrooms and 2 bedrooms with two queens each, plus 4 sofa beds in living areas. 8 real beds; the last 4-8 sleepers are on sofas.
properties.price_note: Listed $400-$757/night by season with a $482 average; December is high season so budget nearer the top. 8 x $482 = $3,856 before the $100/pet fee, cleaning and 11% tax. Books direct with no platform booking fee.
amenities: heated saltwater pool with spa jets
properties.why: The single best manatee property in the region: it sits on its own crescent-shaped island in Kings Bay, and the cove on the property is itself a spring that tour boats bring people to for manatee swims — in the last week of December the manatees come to your dock rather than the other way round. A heated saltwater pool with spa jets, reachable from the sunroom and a master bedroom, covers the days the Gulf is too cold.
properties.cons: FLAGGED: only 4 bedrooms — well below your 6-8BR requirement. It reaches 16 sleepers only by putting 4-8 people on sofa beds in living areas, and 'max 12 adults' is stated. Two bathrooms for 16 people is a serious constraint over 8 days. Included because the manatee-at-the-dock setting is exceptional and directly matches what the family asked for; consider it a 12-person house at best.
properties.availability_note: Listing renders statically but the calendar does not expose dates to automated fetch. Also mirrored on Booking.com. Book direct through FloridaRentals.com (host Michael Eash).

properties.name: Whispering Waves
properties.compound_note: Not a compound, but McCormick manages 18 Cedar Key properties and can block a second unit (e.g. the 3BR Flamingo House, listings/460866, or the 2BR/8 Pink Pearl, listings/211892) to reach 6-7BR for the group. One office, one call.
properties.beds_note: not stated — the listing exposes 109 amenities but no bed configuration.
properties.price_note: Rate loads through a Hostaway widget and was not readable. Cedar Key 4BR waterfront comparables run roughly $300-500/night off-season.
properties.why: The largest house either dominant Cedar Key agency manages, and a good anchor if the family wants Cedar Key itself: a new two-story stilt home over the water with wide views of the Gulf and the outer islands, rated 5.00 across 13 reviews. Pair it with a second McCormick cottage to reach 6-7 bedrooms on one island and one phone call.
properties.cons: FLAGGED: 4 bedrooms, well below your 6-8BR requirement — listed because it is the ceiling of Cedar Key's single-house inventory and the base of the most practical Cedar Key compound. No pool, no dock mentioned, bed configuration unpublished, and no pets. Cedar Key is ~2h15 from Tampa and ~1h20 from the Crystal River manatee springs, so the 'Crystal springs' half of the trip is a day trip from here.
properties.availability_note: Page renders but the Hostaway calendar does not expose Dec 19-27 2026 to automated fetch. Cancellation terms are published: 100% refund to 30 days out, 50% to 14 days.

properties.name: Villa Manta
properties.compound_note: TradeWinds manages a cluster of villas in one gated community, including a 4BR/3.5BA sleeping 8 and a 3BR/2.5BA Cobia duplex sleeping 6. Booking Villa Manta plus the 4BR villa gives 9BR / 18 people inside one gate with a shared private marina — the most credible large-group compound in the Homosassa corridor.
properties.beds_note: not stated — the TradeWinds site returns HTTP 202 to non-browser clients, so only search-snippet detail was available.
properties.price_note: No rates readable — site is behind a bot wall. Call for a Dec 19-27 quote.
amenities: direct Homosassa River and Gulf access
properties.why: A Mediterranean-style 5BR villa inside a gated waterfront community with its own private marina and boat slips, on the Homosassa River — well placed for December manatee season at both Homosassa Springs and Kings Bay. Its real value is as half of a compound: the same manager has a 4BR villa in the same community, which gets the group to 9 bedrooms behind one gate.
properties.cons: FLAGGED: 5 bedrooms sleeping only 10, below your 6-8BR requirement on its own — it needs the paired villa to work for 12-18. Bed configuration, rates and availability are all unknown because the TradeWinds site blocks automated access (HTTP 202 bot wall), so everything here rests on search snippets. Community pool rather than private, and the boat slip is an extra rental. Villa-community character rather than old-Florida character.
properties.availability_note: Site returned HTTP 202 to every automated request; nothing verifiable. Details above come from search snippets only — confirm all of it directly with TradeWinds.

properties.name: Plantation on Crystal River — Golf Villas (multi-villa group booking)
properties.neighborhood: Kings Bay, adjacent to the springs
properties.compound_note: Not a house — the resort has 12 Golf Villas designed for extended stays, plus 11 junior suites, within 196 total accommodations. Booking 2-3 adjacent villas as a block gets the group to roughly 6BR / 16 people on one reservation through the group sales desk. Bedroom and sleeps figures above are an estimate of a 3-villa block, not a single published unit.
properties.beds_note: not stated — per-villa bed configuration is not published; the resort books by phone.
properties.price_note: No published rates; the resort states booking is by phone and the manatee package price is quoted on request.
properties.why: The fallback worth keeping if no single house works: the Plantation sits directly on Kings Bay and its Adventure Center is the one operator that runs organised in-water manatee swims from its own dock — in the last week of December that is the main event, and staying here removes the 6am drive. Restaurants, golf, a marina and a spa on site solve the problem of feeding and occupying 12-18 people for eight days without anyone cooking.
properties.cons: Not a house — this is a 196-room resort, so the family loses the shared-kitchen, everyone-under-one-roof quality they are probably after, and 'bedrooms' only reaches 6-8 by blocking multiple villas. Zero old-Florida character. Booking is phone-only with no online rates, so nothing here is verifiable in advance. December is the resort's peak week and the manatee tours specifically sell out, so both villas and tours need booking well ahead.
properties.availability_note: Resort states booking is by phone only; no online inventory or calendar to check. Contact the group sales desk about a multi-villa block for Dec 19-27 2026.
